groups.operation: Initialize or reset deflate gzip header state
groups.condition: A supported gzip stream reaches header generation after deflateInit2_ or deflateReset.
groups.capability: Keep gzhead null or valid before deflate reads it.
groups.consequence: Invalid gzhead state could disrupt gzip header generation.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same gzhead state requirement across initialization and reset.

groups.operation: Generate a caller-supplied gzip header through deflate
groups.condition: GZIP is enabled and a valid gzip stream uses deflateSetHeader.
groups.capability: Reach custom gzip header generation through deflateSetHeader and deflate.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise caller-supplied gzip header generation.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same missing custom-header input route under the same gzip support condition.
